gates.rule: equals artifact_file_sha256.brief of the COMPLETE FREEZE operation receipt for the same trading day
equals src.premarket.contract.sha256_payload of the artifact without artifact_sha256, as written by src/premarket/planner.py
== RISK_ON selects the LONG leg; == RISK_OFF selects the INVERSE leg; anything else is NO_TRADE
== false / [] / false (Daily Brief invariants stay unchanged)
LONG leg: == LONG_WATCH; INVERSE leg: == SHORT_WATCH and brief.watchlist[i].symbol is a key of direction_scope.inverse_mapping
== true (LONG leg via approved_strategy_templates, INVERSE leg via approved_short_strategy_templates)

decision_input.rank: 0-based index in brief.watchlist; the planner already sorts by score descending then symbol ascending; a mapped INVERSE candidate keeps the FREEZE rank of its SHORT_WATCH item
decision_input.expires_at: brief.expires_at equals the FREEZE time; it only proves the decision was frozen before the open and is not an execution cutoff; the brief is valid only for the REGULAR session of brief.trading_day
decision_input.template_attachment: activation adds premarket_freeze_long_intraday_v1 to approved_strategy_templates (LONG leg) and approved_short_strategy_templates (INVERSE leg) in the Daily Brief config and makes the normalizer attach it to candidates; SHORT approval of any symbol other than TQQQ or SOXL never makes it tradable; this happens only in the implementation issue after review and receipt
decision_input.template_id_meaning: long in premarket_freeze_long_intraday_v1 means long positions only; the INVERSE leg is also a long position (in an inverse ETF), so the id is unchanged

direction_scope.inverse_leg: a gated SHORT_WATCH on TQQQ buys SQQQ and on SOXL buys SOXS; this is a long position in an inverse ETF (no borrow, no short dividend obligation); every other SHORT_WATCH item stays OBSERVATION_ONLY
direction_scope.long_leg_allowlist: a LONG-leg symbol must be in the FREEZE snapshot payload.policy_config.allowed_symbols AND (leverage factor 1 per src.universe.screener.leverage_for OR one of index_3x_etfs_traded_as_long_watch); the signal symbol of the INVERSE leg must also be in allowed_symbols and the traded targets are exactly the inverse_mapping values; the allowlist, not the incomplete leverage table, is the primary guard
direction_scope.leveraged_etp_disclosure: 3x ETFs have larger gap and intraday risk than the underlying index; live trading of leveraged or inverse ETPs may require broker or regulatory prerequisites (for example account eligibility steps) that must be verified before any live review
direction_scope.short_reason: current position and cash accounting cannot open and value negative share positions; borrow and dividend obligations are not modeled

account.position_book_rule: one position book; sizing, exposure, marks and risk halts use only the recorded Paper ledger; official and stress ledgers are derived report-only views of the same fills and never change positions

entry.fill: open of the REGULAR 1m bar that starts exactly at 09:35:00 ET; all gated candidates are decided together at that bar open, so sizing needs no later information

portfolio.per_symbol_weight_cap_reason: whole shares in a USD 2,000 account made fixed per-symbol weights unreachable for high-priced symbols (v1.1); risk is bounded by the total exposure cap
portfolio.exposure_cap_derivation: largest 5%-step exposure with exposure * (stop_loss_pct + stress round trip) < daily loss halt: 0.75 * (0.0075 + 0.0051) = 0.00945 < 0.01
portfolio.minimum_order_notional_basis: quantity * entry_fill_price; Toss documents a USD 1 minimum per fractional order in its app, unverified for the Open API (assumption)
portfolio.fractional_execution: Toss Open API (openapi.json schemas OrderCreateAmountBased and OrderCreateQuantityBased) accepts US fractional BUY only as a MARKET order by USD orderAmount and fractional SELL only as a MARKET order with at most 6 decimal places, both only from the regular open until 1 hour before the close (errors amount-order-outside-regular-hours, fractional-quantity-outside-regular-hours, fractional-quantity-scale-exceeded); Paper models the fill at the reference open with the contract slippage and costs
portfolio.fractional_execution_window: every fractional position must be closed before the regular close minus 60 minutes (15:00 ET, 12:00 ET on an early close); entry at the 09:35 ET bar and the 60-minute time exit close positions at the 10:35 ET bar open, inside that window; EOD_FLATTEN (close minus 10 minutes) is kept only as a backstop and a live implementation would have to flatten by close minus 60 minutes
portfolio.fractional_leveraged_etp_eligibility: TQQQ, SOXL, SQQQ and SOXS fractional eligibility at Toss is unverified; Paper assumes eligible; verify before any live review
portfolio.leveraged_etp_exposure_basis: price notional (leverage factor 1) for TQQQ, SOXL, SQQQ and SOXS in sizing, exposure and risk
portfolio.sizing_equity: recorded-ledger marked equity E at the entry bar open, before any entry of the session
sizing_procedure: eligible = gated candidates that have the 09:35 bar, in rank order (known at the 09:35 bar open)
for each eligible candidate with k eligible candidates remaining (including itself): room = cap - used; budget = room / k
qty = floor(budget / cash_per_share) to 6 decimal places
if qty == 0 then NO_TRADE_SYMBOL with reason EXPOSURE_ROOM
if qty * entry_fill_price < minimum_order_notional_usd then NO_TRADE_SYMBOL with reason BELOW_MIN_ORDER_NOTIONAL
portfolio.traded_instrument_bar: the traded instrument (the mapped inverse ETF for the INVERSE leg) supplies its own 09:35 bar and reference open; a missing bar is NO_TRADE_SYMBOL

priority_within_bar: at bar open: pending risk-halt liquidations, then TIME_EXIT and EOD_FLATTEN due at or before this bar, then new entries
intrabar: STOP_LOSS or TAKE_PROFIT for positions still open, including positions entered at this bar open
at bar close: mark all positions at the bar close and evaluate risk limits; a breach schedules liquidation at the next bar open
exits.stop_and_target_base: recorded entry_fill_price (after entry slippage, before commission)
exits.stop_reference_fill: bar open if bar open < stop_price, otherwise stop_price
exits.target_reference_fill: target_price; favorable gap improvement is not credited
exits.exit_slippage_and_costs: after selecting the reference fill, apply 5bp adverse slippage, then 10bp commission and the SEC fee on the sell notional
exits.time_exit_anchor: start of the entry fill bar
exits.time_exit_fill: first available REGULAR 1m bar open at or after anchor + 60 minutes
exits.eod_flatten_time: scheduled regular close minus 10 minutes (15:50 ET on a normal day, 12:50 ET on an early close), from snapshot.payload.schedule.market_close_utc
exits.eod_fill: first available REGULAR 1m bar open at or after the EOD flatten time
exits.mark_price: close of the latest completed REGULAR 1m bar
exits.missing_exit_bar: exit at the next available REGULAR 1m bar open; if no bar remains before the regular close, keep the last mark, record UNRESOLVED_EXIT and treat the session as an operational failure; the carried position is liquidated at the next session's first REGULAR 1m bar open and the remaining sessions are HALTED

execution_costs.broker_fee_source: Toss Securities official FAQ checked 2026-09-30: US stock commission 0.1% on buy and 0.1% on sell; SEC fee 0.00206% of sell notional (minimum USD 0.01) from executions on or after 2026-04-02
execution_costs.official_incremental_formula: ((0.34 - 0.30) / 2) pct points * actual filled notional on each side
execution_costs.stress_incremental_formula: ((0.51 - 0.30) / 2) pct points * actual filled notional on each side
execution_costs.official_and_stress_reporting: subtract the per-side incremental drag from recorded Paper equity/PnL; never subtract the full 0.34 or 0.51 again; the recorded SEC fee is not netted against the increment
execution_costs.account_event_fee_rule: if the account's actual event commission differs, the first-session receipt records it; the contract rates above still apply for the whole window

operating_costs.method: recurring costs invoiced only for services used by this system during the window, allocated by window sessions / trading sessions in the billing period; shared personal subscriptions and personal time are excluded
operating_costs.fixed_in: first-session receipt, before the first future session, with the itemized list or 0.0 and the reason
operating_costs.reporting: report after trading costs and after operating costs separately

implementation_binding.purpose: how the adapter must configure existing components so that they enforce this contract without a second PnL engine or blocked exits

risk_config.max_consecutive_losses_reason: non-binding: 10 sessions * 3 positions + 1; not a contract rule
risk_config.reentry_cooldown: disabled; same-day re-entry is already forbidden by entry.max_entries_per_symbol_per_day

implementation_binding.risk_leverage_rule: every OrderIntent and risk Position of this adapter uses leverage_factor 1 (price notional) instead of src.universe.screener.leverage_for, so TQQQ, SOXL, SQQQ and SOXS count at price notional and RiskManager cannot reject an entry the sizing procedure accepted
implementation_binding.client_order_id: BUY: pfl1-{entry trading day YYYYMMDD}-{traded symbol}-BUY, single attempt (no re-entry); SELL: pfl1-{entry trading day YYYYMMDD}-{traded symbol}-SELL-{n}, n starts at 1 per position and increments only after a rejected, unfilled or partially filled sell of that position; at most one sell attempt per symbol per bar; a rejected, unfilled or partially filled exit (including STOP_LOSS and TAKE_PROFIT) is kept pending with its reason and retries unconditionally at the next available bar open (also for a carried position), without re-checking the price level; replaying the same inputs yields the same ids and a stored id is never resubmitted or refilled
implementation_binding.exit_fill_quantity: an exit fill must equal the held quantity; if it differs by more than 1e-9 the remainder stays open, an EXIT_FILL_QUANTITY_MISMATCH event is recorded and the remainder retries at the next bar
implementation_binding.bar_validity: a 1m bar is valid only if open, high, low and close are finite and > 0 and low <= min(open, close) and max(open, close) <= high; an invalid bar is recorded as INVALID_BAR and treated exactly as a missing bar (missing_entry_bar, missing_exit_bar and mark rules apply)
implementation_binding.risk_quantity_reduction: if RiskManager returns a reduced quantity for an entry, reject the entry (REJECT_ENTRY); never submit a quantity other than the sized 6-decimal quantity
implementation_binding.entry_risk_inputs: entry intents use intent.price = reference_open and snapshot account_value = the sizing equity E for every entry of the session, and positions entered earlier at the same bar are marked at their reference_open in that snapshot, so the RiskManager exposure check measures the same base as the sizing procedure and cannot reject an entry the procedure accepted

order_kinds.rule: every exit uses a RISK_REDUCING kind so kill switch, daily-loss and drawdown gates never block it; exits never consult AI

implementation_binding.fees_in_fills: FillEvent.fee = commission + SEC fee for that fill, so net_pnl == gross_pnl - slippage - commission still holds in the single FIFO PnL engine; the SEC part may be kept as an audit field
implementation_binding.fee_rounding: commission is not rounded; SEC fee = max(0.01, sell notional * 0.0000206 rounded up to the cent), computed with decimal.Decimal from the float values to avoid binary floating-point rounding
implementation_binding.quantity_floor: decimal.Decimal on str() of the float inputs with every rounding toward floor, quantized to 6 decimal places; no epsilon
implementation_binding.derived_ledgers: official and stress views are pure read-only aggregation over recorded fills (filled notional * per-side increment) subtracted from FIFO results; they never re-match lots
implementation_binding.daily_loss_anchor_input: the adapter marks flat recorded equity before the 09:35 bar each session (equal to the prior regular close when flat) and passes the prior-close equity explicitly when a position was carried by UNRESOLVED_EXIT
implementation_binding.exit_generator_extension: stop and target use completed-bar low/high with the gap reference fills above, and the time exit counts minutes from the entry bar start, not bar count; the current price-only ExitSignalGenerator must be extended in the implementation issue

risk.mark_frequency: every completed REGULAR 1m bar close and every fill
risk.daily_loss_anchor: prior trading day regular-close recorded equity; first session uses initial equity
risk.high_water_anchor: highest external-flow-adjusted recorded marked equity since Paper start
risk.breach_liquidation_fill: next available REGULAR 1m bar open with Paper exit slippage, commission and SEC fee
breach_includes: recorded slippage, commission and SEC fee
risk.sessions_after_halt: recorded as HALTED scheduled sessions without new entries until the user approves resumption; never dropped

evaluation.first_session: set by immutable implementation receipt before the first future run
evaluation.window_start: regular close of the NYSE trading day before the first scheduled session (recorded equity = initial equity)
evaluation.window_end: regular close of the 10th scheduled session
evaluation.account_return: recorded-ledger TWR over the window with official and stress incremental costs applied as derived views; no external flows are allowed

benchmark.gate_benchmark: SPY total return over the same window: unadjusted regular closes, close-to-close, with each ex-dividend cash dividend reinvested at the ex-date close (never combined with dividend-adjusted closes)
benchmark.spy_dividend_rule: if an SPY ex-dividend date falls inside the window and its amount is not verified from a named source, the benchmark is INCONCLUSIVE_BENCHMARK
benchmark.official_sp500_total_return: reported separately; INCONCLUSIVE_BENCHMARK while no source is wired; SPY is never labeled as the S&P 500 Total Return index

primary_metrics_order: excess return versus same-window SPY total return
eligibility_conditions: official-cost and operating-cost cumulative account return > 0
same-window SPY total-return excess > 0 using the official-cost account return
no daily or high-water risk halt occurred
shutdown, restart, reconciliation and EOD exit paths verified; EOD and restart paths by deterministic replay tests before the receipt, plus daily reconciliation during the window

outcome_precedence.when: any risk halt, duplicate order, unresolved mismatch or UNRESOLVED_EXIT
completed trades = 0, benchmark INCONCLUSIVE_BENCHMARK, any scheduled session missing or incomplete, or a required path unverified; state only the missing evidence
all data and operating conditions pass but any economic condition fails

evaluation.leg_reporting: report the LONG leg and the INVERSE leg separately in addition to the account total; INVERSE-leg results are never approved as LONG performance
